title: Multilingual Large Language Models: A Systematic Survey
findings: This survey paper notes that research into the cultural adaptation of LLMs includes efforts to measure cultural bias, citing a study that uses scenarios involving religious practices (e.g., 'having beer after prayer'). The survey itself does not present original findings on religion but includes this as part of the broader research landscape on cultural alignment.
